free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports further investigation due to the high-risk PI-RADS 5 lesion (14 mm) and the rising PSA trend, which contradicts the prior positive biopsy status. The PSA trend shows a significant rise from 1.2 ng/mL (Mar 2024) to 10.0 ng/mL (Jan 2025), and the PI-RADS 5 finding warrants sampling to assess for progression or recurrence.
